name: card-select
prompt: A single playing card softly lifted and slid across a felt card table, brief paper whisper

name: card-play
prompt: A playing card placed firmly face-up onto a wooden card table, crisp snap with a soft felt thud

name: card-deal
prompt: Playing cards dealt rapidly one by one across a felt table, quick rhythmic paper flicks

name: bid-place
prompt: A small wooden bidding token tapped decisively twice on a polished table, dry knock

name: bid-pass
prompt: A single soft dismissive finger tap on a padded card table, muted low thump

name: spade-trump
prompt: A heavy playing card slapped down with a deep resonant thud and a short dramatic metallic ring

name: trick-win
prompt: A small stack of playing cards gathered and scooped toward the winner, warm paper shuffle ending in a satisfying soft chime

name: trick-lose
prompt: Playing cards gently pulled away across felt, a quiet descending paper shuffle

name: invalid-move
prompt: A short muted double knock on wood, dull and disapproving, no resonance

name: round-start
prompt: A full deck of playing cards shuffled once and squared with a clean riffle and a single tap

name: round-end
prompt: Score tokens counted and stacked on a wooden table, soft clicks ending in a gentle settle

name: game-win
prompt: A warm celebratory brass bell chime with a soft cascade of cards fanned across felt

name: game-lose
prompt: A low muffled gong with cards softly set down, subdued and final

name: ui-click
prompt: A short clean wooden button click, tight attack with minimal decay

name: ui-open
prompt: A soft panel sliding open, gentle felt and wood friction sweep

name: new-game
prompt: A deck of playing cards squared with a crisp double tap followed by a bright inviting shuffle
